faq_heading: Lackner real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Lackner is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 29 homes sold there: 21 houses and 7 townhomes. 21 houses sold in Lackner with a median price of $1,765,000 (the middle half sold between $1,600,000 and $2,145,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list.
Lackner home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

21 houses sold in Lackner with a median price of $1,765,000 (the middle half sold between $1,600,000 and $2,145,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $672 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 4,809 square feet. 7 townhomes sold in Lackner with a median price of $1,104,000, taking a median of 25 days to sell at 94.0% of the last list price; 14% sold above list. They had a median $630 per square foot, a median year built of 2000 and a median strata fee of $400 a month.

faq.q: What did homes in Lackner sell for?
faq.a: 21 houses sold in Lackner between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,765,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Lackner?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Lackner sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 21 houses that sold in Lackner went for between $1,600,000 and $2,145,000, around a median of $1,765,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Lackner sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 21 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.0% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Lackner?
faq.a: The median year built was 1990 for the 21 houses sold in Lackner.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Lackner usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Lackner had 5 bedrooms, from the 21 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Richmond?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
